label: Starbucks opens, we change nothing
description: ROADMAP B4 control for S2: the entrant arrives on day 4 but Simffee keeps 06:30 and the 45k latte. Forked from s2_entrant at day 4 with the hours/price shift removed via `unset`, so days 1-3 are shared byte for byte and the only difference between the two branches is what Simffee did.
